out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock Removed from Tagged or Labeled Container
violations.observation: Shellstock has been removed from the tagged/labeled container without preserving source identification. Shellstock tags had been removed from the container of clams.
violations.corrective_action: Shellstock that has been removed from the tagged/labeled container must have a system used to identify source. PIC THREW AWAY CLAMS THAT DID NOT HAVE PROPER LABELING OR SHELLSTOCK TAGS.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Cutting knives were being stored between the 2DR prep top unit and the prep table to the right of the prep top unit.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THE CORRECT WAY TO STORE IN USE UTENSILS TO KEEP CLEAN IN BETWEEN EACH USE. PIC REMOVED THE KNIVES TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED AND THEN PLACED IN A DEEP PAN TO STORE BETWEEN USES.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: 4 knives were being stored in between the 2DR prep top unit and a prep table.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THEY CANNOT STORE KNIVES IN AREAS THAT CANNOT BE PROPERLY WASHED RINSED AND SANITIZED. PIC MOVED KNIVES TO 3 VAT SINK TO BE PROPERLY WASHED.
